vocab.meaning_vi: sắp xếp câu trả lời có bố cục
vocab.example: I always structure an answer so the interviewer can follow me easily.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi luôn sắp xếp câu trả lời có bố cục để người phỏng vấn dễ theo dõi.

vocab.example: Let me give you the context first, then I will explain my actions.
vocab.example_vi: Để tôi đưa ra bối cảnh trước, rồi tôi sẽ giải thích những việc tôi đã làm.

vocab.example: A specific example is always stronger than a general sentence about teamwork.
vocab.example_vi: Một ví dụ cụ thể luôn mạnh hơn một câu chung chung về làm việc nhóm.

vocab.example: May I walk you through the three steps I took last year?
vocab.example_vi: Tôi có thể dẫn anh qua từng bước trong ba việc tôi đã làm năm ngoái không?

vocab.example: I try to end every story with a measurable number, not just a feeling.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi cố kết thúc mỗi câu chuyện bằng một con số đo lường được, không chỉ là cảm nhận.

vocab.example: The impact of that change was clear: fewer complaints from our customers.
vocab.example_vi: Tác động của thay đổi đó rất rõ: ít lời phàn nàn hơn từ khách hàng của chúng tôi.

vocab.example: Please keep your answer concise, about two minutes is enough.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy giữ câu trả lời ngắn gọn, khoảng hai phút là đủ.

vocab.example: In the last part I highlight what I learned from that project.
vocab.example_vi: Ở phần cuối tôi nhấn mạnh điều tôi học được từ dự án đó.

listening.title: Answering a question with the STAR structure

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Minh, tell me about a time when you solved a difficult problem at work.

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: Certainly. May I walk you through it using the STAR structure?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Please do. That makes it easier for me to follow.

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: For context, last year our monthly report took two full days to prepare.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: And what was your own task in that situation?

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: My task was to cut that time by half before the new quarter started.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: What actions did you take? Please keep it concise.

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: I mapped the manual steps, built one template, and trained four colleagues to use it.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: Good. Can you give me a measurable result?

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Preparation time dropped from sixteen hours to five, so we saved eleven hours monthly.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Interviewer)
lines.text: That is a real impact. What would you highlight from that experience?

lines.speaker: Minh (Candidate)
lines.text: I learned that training people matters as much as building the tool itself.

questions.q: What structure does Minh use for his answer?
options: A short story with no numbers
To cut the reporting time by half
To write a new company policy
The report became easier to read
The team grew from four to eight people
Preparation time dropped from sixteen hours to five

shadowing: The situation was that our main client asked for a report every week.
My task was to build the new template and train four team members.
I will walk you through the actions I took in a concise way.
